content.short: LetsExchange is an instant swap service covering several thousand cryptocurrencies.
content.description: LetsExchange offers instant swaps across a very large asset list, aggregating rates from multiple liquidity sources so that long-tail tokens remain tradeable without listing on a major venue. Monad's documentation lists it under cross-chain tooling. Breadth of coverage is the main differentiator in this category, and it is the reason these services persist alongside DEX aggregators.
